g:mire_colossus: Risen from the Kabarian mire where the kingdom of El Anure drowned.
g:heartwood_ancient: Its roots drank from the springs of Myrh before the Oath was broken.
g:mountain_king: He held Harmon Fort until the ice closed the pass behind him.
g:crystal_matriarch: Her brood grew fat on the cold light of the Underrealm.
g:brass_colossus: Forged in the Titanium Quarry of Mardoth, and never told to stop.
g:void_archon: A splinter of the first rupture, still looking for the way home.
g:oathwarden: It held the sky's oath. When the oath broke, it held on to the sky.
g:sand_matriarch: She buried the Lost City of the Desolated Plains once already.
g:ossuary_king: Crowned in the Burying Grounds of Mardoth, by the dead, for the dead.
g:bone_sovereign: Skorch's ash still clings to his bones.
g:cyclops_tyrant: Kin of Min Loduhr: what it cannot rule, it eats.
g:alpha_werewolf: The pack ran the Passage of Ash long before the settlers came.
g:ogre_warlord: Zul forged worlds. His blood only forges grudges.
g:hydra: The oldest hunger of the Kabarian Wetlands, and the most patient.
g:rock_titan: A cliff of Mardoth that learned to walk.
g:demon_warlord: Archeron's banner-bearer, come to collect what was sworn.
g:hellguard_captain: Sworn to Archeron. The oath held; the man did not.
g:vampire_lord: An echo of the Nightshade, wearing a nobleman's face.
g:ashen_wyrm: Elysia's brood still smoulders where the Ash Weaver fell.
g:elysia: Mother of the Ashen brood. Something warm still stirs beneath her.
g:jarl_hrafn: He swore his axe to the Oath, then sold it to the north wind.
g:hollow_knight: An oath-knight who kept his vow long after his heart gave out.
g:centaur_chieftain: He led the herds of Myrh when the Oath still held the meadows.
g:deep_warden: The dwarves sealed their dead below the halls and set a warden on the door. It still keeps it.
g:steel_guardian: The Tinkers wound it to guard their forges. No one came back to stop it.
g:antlered_hunger: It starved through the long winter under the old woods, and learned to call the roots to hold its meat still.
g:crystal_crasher: It broke out of the deep veins under Mardoth, and kept the crystals that grew on it.
g:anubis: He weighed every heart that entered the necropolis. He weighs yours.
